title: X, not Y recount judgments
description: The recorded judgment for each candidate the X, not Y recount tool (.github/scripts/check-x-not-y.py) finds, in .github/scripts/x-not-y-judgments.json. Each page path maps its candidate keys to their judgments. The tool checks the same shape as it loads the file, and also refuses a repeated key and NaN or Infinity, which JSON Schema cannot express; tests/test_check_x_not_y.py runs every example under schemas/examples/x-not-y-judgments/ through both, so the two stay in step.

additionalProperties.description: One page's judgments, by candidate key.

propertyNames.description: A candidate key, <kind>|<sentence text>|<occurrence>, with the quotation context after it for a sentence in a block quote. The tool's JUDGMENT_KEY_RE holds the same form.

pagePath.description: A repository path to a Markdown page, such as framework/docs/glossary.md: it ends in .md and starts with neither / nor ../.

line.description: The line the candidate starts on, counting from 1. The tool refreshes it; it is not part of the key.

judgment.description: device: an X, not Y instance; split: a split negation; banned: the banned It's not X. It's Y. shape; no: none of these.

reason.description: Why, in one short clause. It holds more than white space, in the tool's reading too: a character outside ECMA-262's \s, U+001C to U+001F and U+0085.
